sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN trans AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', T1.birth_date) BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976' AND T4.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND T4.amount > 4000
